title: Addiction pathways may date from early multicellularity

statements.text: If multicellularity needed a way for cells to keep other cells nearby, the addictive power of opiates may derive from such ancient roots, which can be tested in early multicellular models and cell co-cultures.

prediction.resolution_criterion: Experiments targeting addiction pathways in early multicellular models or somatic and stem cell co-cultures show an ancient role for addictive neurochemicals in keeping cells together.

sources.quote: This suggests the testable hypothesis that the addictive power of opiates and similar molecules derives from such ancient roots.
